column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 to NIST AI RMF (nist_ai_600_1 GenAI Profile component) Schema Mappings

# mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System) LinkML schema and the NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile (loaded via the NIST AI RMF umbrella schema). The Generative AI Profile is a companion to AI RMF 1.0 and enumerates GAI-specific risks (CBRN, confabulation, data privacy, intellectual property, etc.) and suggested actions. Mappings capture the overlap between ISO 42001's AI risk, incident, and treatment classes and the GAI profile's risk-taxonomy and suggested-action structure.
